note: The base product's allow-list of the absolute-URL rule (fe-country-split-plan §4.11 rule 5; build-urls-check.mjs --absolute), which every country build runs over both applications' dist (country-kit/check-build.mjs). An entry is { pattern: <a regular expression's source, matched against the start of the URL found>, files?: <a glob over the dist's paths>, reason }: one without a reason, with an unknown field or a pattern that is not one fails the check. Measured, not guessed, over the dists of build, build:info and the example country's two builds; no wildcard host. A country's own address goes in its fe/build-urls-allowed.json, in this format, each entry one literal https URL ending with $ and its reason (country-kit/README.md); this list carries no country's address (R1).

allow.reason: XML namespace names (SVG, XHTML, XLink, MathML, XML, XML Schema) that Angular's renderer and OpenLayers' parsers compare against: identifiers, never fetched
OpenLayers' names of the KML namespace and of the projections it knows: identifiers, never fetched
OpenLayers' KML format: the namespace names of the KML versions it reads, identifiers, never fetched
OpenLayers' KML format: the schema location it writes into a KML document it serialises, never fetched
OpenLayers' KML format: the default placemark icon of a KML document read without styles; the administration app draws no KML icon, and its CSP's img-src admits no such origin
the tile template of the OpenStreetMap layer, the default of the osmUrl setting (the CSP's img-src admits the tile origins of the current settings)
the tile template of the OpenSeaMap layer, the default of the openSeaMapUrl setting (shared-map/layers/ol-openseamap-layer.ts)
the map's attribution link, which OpenStreetMap's licence asks for: a link a reader follows, never loaded
the administration app's documentationUrl, where its help links point: a link a user follows, never loaded
a link in the administration app's coordinate help to a map of the UTM zones: an anchor a user follows, never loaded
the base a script resolves a relative address against (keycloak-js's default redirect, Angular's router and URL parsing): never requested
documentation links in a library's error messages and licence comments (Angular, its service worker, keycloak-js, ProseMirror): text, never loaded
